main_topic.h_title: Most shops send you off to find a bed. We hand you the key.

primary_content.text: Carabao is one of the few places on Koh Tao where your accommodation, your SSI dive school, the beach bar, the pool and the boat all share one beachfront in Chalok Bay. Book once, unpack once, and let the whole day happen between your room and the water.

main_topic.h_title: Learn to dive — and sleep on the beach for free.

primary_content.text: Our Open Water course is ฿9,900. Add three nights in the beachfront dormitory and the price stays ฿9,900 — the bed is on us. Roll out of bed, cross the sand, step onto the boat.

main_topic.h_title: From first breath to pro.

primary_content.text: Small groups — max four on Open Water — with instructors who live and dive here, taught in English, Italian, German, Spanish, French or Thai. Every course pairs with a room next door.

main_topic.h_title: Minutes from the bay to some of Thailand's best water.

primary_content.text: Granite pinnacles, turtle bays and the Gulf's most famous chimney — most within a 20–45 minute boat ride of Chalok Bay.
Pinnacle · 14–36m
Pinnacles · 5–30m

main_topic.h_title: Chumphon Pinnacle

primary_content.text: Koh Tao's signature granite pinnacle, wrapped in barracuda and giant grouper — and the island's best shot at a whale shark in green season.

main_topic.h_title: Southwest Pinnacle

primary_content.text: A cluster of granite pinnacles draped in pink soft coral and circled by barracuda and trevally — one of Koh Tao's most beautiful sites, and a green-season whale-shark favourite.

main_topic.h_title: Minutes from the bay to some of Thailand's best water.

primary_content.text: Turtles & coral · 5–24m
Green season · the big one

main_topic.h_title: Shark Bay

primary_content.text: Shallow, calm and full of green turtles and blacktip reef sharks — the perfect training reef and a gentle, joyful fun dive.

main_topic.h_title: The chance to share the blue with a whale shark.

primary_content.text: From late in the year, the Gulf's gentle giants cruise the pinnacles around Koh Tao. There's no guarantee — but when they appear, it's the dive you'll talk about forever.

main_topic.h_title: You came for the diving. You'll stay for the people.

primary_content.text: When the tanks are rinsed the day is just getting going — sunset volleyball, a cold drink at the beach bar, and a crew of divers from all over the world who turn into family by the end of the week.

main_topic.h_title: Can I stay and dive in the same place on Koh Tao?

primary_content.text: Yes — that's the whole idea. Carabao is one of the few places on Koh Tao where your accommodation, the SSI dive centre, the pool, the restaurant and the dive boat all share one beachfront in Chalok Bay. You book once and everything happens between your room and the water.

main_topic.h_title: How much is the Open Water course?

primary_content.text: The SSI Open Water Diver course is ฿9,900 over 3–4 days. As a Dive & Stay package it includes three nights' dormitory accommodation for the same ฿9,900, or a private air-conditioned room for ฿10,900.

main_topic.h_title: Is accommodation really included with courses?

primary_content.text: Yes. Every SSI course and fun-dive package can be bundled with a room on the beach, so you pay less than booking the diving and the bed separately.

main_topic.h_title: What languages are courses taught in?

primary_content.text: English, Italian, German, Spanish, French and Thai — by instructors who live and dive on Koh Tao, always in small groups.

main_topic.h_title: Arrive & settle in

primary_content.text: We pick you up at the pier and check you into your beachfront room. Unpack once, then enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace by the pool.

main_topic.h_title: Dive & explore

primary_content.text: A morning theory session, then your first dives in the clear water off Koh Tao. Surface to the pool and the beach bar, with your instructor close the whole time.

main_topic.h_title: Certify & celebrate

primary_content.text: Complete your final dives, become a certified diver, and celebrate your achievement at sunset with the new friends you made along the way.

main_topic.h_title: Stay, dive, and never leave the beach.

primary_content.text: Message us on WhatsApp and we'll build a dive & stay package around your dates. No deposit needed to start the conversation.
